rationale: Price is sitting at 83.5% of today's range near the session high with momentum stalling — the last three 1-minute candles show declining volume and a tight range around $28.60-$28.62, suggesting the intraday push is losing steam. The earnings news (released ~18 hours ago) revealed significantly elevated non-performing assets and loans versus estimates, creating a fundamental headwind for longs, yet the stock has already recovered well above its gap-down open, limiting short conviction as well. With the spread tight and relative volume elevated, the risk/reward for either direction is unclear given the conflicting signals between price recovery and credit quality deterioration.
